reviewer: Claude Fable 5.2 (agent), every ring on the 2025-06-14 orthophoto beside the 2021-04-16 leaf-off photo (render-ring-sheets.py)

accepted.castle-tee-06-1: Under crown shade in June 2025; the laser platform is the measurement and the 2021 leaf-off photo shows mown ground on it. Card residual 0.0 m.
accepted.castle-tee-08-2: Half in tree shadow in June 2025; the 2021 leaf-off photo shows the whole mown deck on the laser platform. Card residual 0.0 m.
accepted.castle-tee-09-1: Under crowns in June 2025; the 2021 leaf-off photo shows the mown deck in the clearing. Card residual 1.9 m.
accepted.castle-tee-11-1: In deep crown shade in June 2025; the 2021 leaf-off photo shows mown ground beside the path here. Card residual 0.0 m.
accepted.castle-tee-11-2: A small deck no card colour uses, at the edge of crown shade; a pale mown strip on both photos.
accepted.castle-tee-14-2: An L-shaped deck partly under crowns; its outline follows the mown ground on the 2021 leaf-off photo. Card residual 0.0 m.

castle-tee-11-1.reason: Angular outline lying wholly on tree crowns in the summer photo; the leaf-off photo shows bare branches over it and only a small green patch at its south end, no mown deck filling the line.
castle-tee-11-1.fault: The terrain has a flat deck 5 by 13 m at 23.5 m under the western two thirds of the ring (E 648716-648721, N 6598936-6598948). The OSM ring is 8 m wide and hangs 2-3 m over the east bank (9% slope inside it). To redraw as a laser platform at the next trace.

castle-tee-18-3.reason: Narrow sharp-cornered rectangle on ordinary mid-green ground beside the trees, while the summer photo shows a bright mown rectangle about 8 m east of it, outside the line; no deck shows inside the line on either photo.
castle-tee-18-3.fault: Right: the blue deck mown in June 2025 lies 8 m to the east, on ground that is water in the terrain (the pond corner was filled after it was flown). The ring was drawn on the level strip beside it (1.0% slope). Right again when the terrain is renewed.

castle-tee-18-2.reason: A perfect sharp-cornered rectangle on turf of the same tone inside and out in the summer photo; I can see no deck edge that it follows, and the leaf-off photo shows only a vaguely darker patch there.
castle-tee-18-2.fault: Right: the yellow deck mown in June 2025 lies about 12 m to the north-east. The pond corner was filled after the terrain was flown, so that ground is water in the model, and the ring was drawn on the level ground beside it (1.1% slope). Right again when the terrain is renewed.

castle-tee-06-1.reason: Ragged outline that follows the gap between tree crowns rather than a deck edge; pale mown turf continues past its south-east end in the summer photo, and the leaf-off photo is in deep shadow.
castle-tee-06-1.resolution: The terrain has a flat platform under the ring: 61 cells within 3 cm of a plane, sloping 0.7%, 0.19 m above the ground round it. Crowns hide its edge on both photos, so the ring is the platform's and not the photo's.

castle-bunker-07-1.reason: Years disagree: the line fits clean sand on the summer photo, but the leaf-off photo (washed out here) shows turf and no sand inside it.
castle-bunker-07-1.resolution: The outline follows the sand of June 2025, the tracing photo. The bunker is newer than the terrain: there is no bowl under it (its floor lies 0.06 m above its rim), so it is drawn as flat sand on a 6% slope. Listed in the walkthrough.

castle-bunker-07-4.reason: Years disagree: the line fits the summer sand, but on the leaf-off photo the sand is only a small patch in the middle of the line and the rest is dark ground.
castle-bunker-07-4.resolution: The outline follows the sand of June 2025. The bunker was enlarged after April 2021, and the terrain has the older, smaller bowl (the floor 0.55 m below the rim). Listed in the walkthrough.

castle-bunker-17-1.reason: Years disagree: the line fits sand on the summer photo, but on the leaf-off photo it encloses a dark hollow with no sand, while the neighbouring bunker shows sand on both.
castle-bunker-17-1.resolution: The outline follows the sand of June 2025. In April 2021 this was a grassed hollow, and the terrain has that hollow (the floor 0.72 m below the rim), so the sand lies in a bowl. Listed in the walkthrough.

castle-bunker-07-2.reason: Years disagree: the line fits the summer sand, but on the leaf-off photo sand shows only in its south half and the north half is dark.
castle-bunker-07-2.resolution: The outline follows the sand of June 2025. The bunker was enlarged after April 2021, and the terrain has the older, smaller bowl (the floor 0.30 m below the rim). Listed in the walkthrough.

castle-bunker-07-3.reason: Years disagree: one joined bunker on the summer photo, which the line follows, but two separate sand patches with a dark gap between them on the leaf-off photo.
castle-bunker-07-3.resolution: The outline follows the sand of June 2025, where the two bunkers of April 2021 were joined into one. The terrain has the older pair's bowls (the floor 0.74 m below the rim). Listed in the walkthrough.
